items.title: Fruit revenue doubles to Tk 6,000cr in 5yrs though imports fall
items.description: Bangladesh collected nearly Tk 6,000 crore in import duties on fresh fruits such as apples, oranges, grapes and mandarins in the fiscal year 2025-26, almost double its revenue five years earlier, even as import volumes slumped.

items.title: SK hynix posts seven-fold surge in operating profit
items.description: South Korean chip giant SK hynix on Wednesday reported a 632 percent surge in third-quarter operating profit, fuelled by booming demand for AI semiconductors, and unveiled plans to return an additional $45 billion to shareholders.
